panels.title: Canonical hierarchy and captured evidence · static snapshot

options.content: **Static diagnostic snapshot.** The time picker does not filter these rows. Select Request → Side; the global table shows every canonical L1–L4 node, while Parent Id controls only the child browser. API Server, EngineCore and Worker are L1 groups. Native phases are L4 children of put; native calls and totals remain evidence metadata. Shared batch, execution, rank and task samples retain their full identities and must not be attributed as per-request time. Parent/child ranges, parallel ranks, associated stages and native totals can overlap: **do not sum them into TTFT**. Official TTFT is shown only when first_token_observed is true. The field evidence table includes every captured stage, associated stage, counter, official field and native call/total without aggregation; raw values and source observations are inspectable. Missing, skipped, event, group and association durations remain null (—); zero is a captured value. Synthetic inputs remain diagnostic examples, not performance measurements.

panels.title: Global L1–L4 hierarchy · every canonical node
panels.description: Direct l1/l2/l3/l4 ancestry from /nodes; independent of Parent Id. All canonical stages and states are retained. Shared batch and overlapping ranges are non-additive. Native call IDs and totals are evidence metadata, not an L5 tree level. Null durations remain missing; inspect source_observations or row_evidence for provenance. Queue intervals are associated with the execution ending the wait, not time inside that execution. Hash/detokenize ranges retain explicit execution identity; unassigned intervals remain request-level.

panels.title: Execution and rank evidence · full identities · non-additive
panels.description: Canonical execution, task and rank samples, retaining full execution_id without process-specific parsing. Shared batch rows can be associated with several requests; parallel ranks and parent ranges must never be summed. This view retains nullable ranks and all canonical context; use column filters to inspect an execution or rank. Queue intervals are associated with the execution ending the wait, not time inside that execution. Hash/detokenize ranges retain explicit execution identity; unassigned intervals remain request-level.

panels.title: Captured field evidence · all stages, counters, official and native fields
panels.description: One row per captured field from /observations, including stages, associated_stages, counters, every official statistic and native totals/calls. No sums, pivoting, deduplication or business-node invention. Value is JSON text so booleans, zero, strings and structured payloads are inspectable; absent values remain null. Official raw evidence does not override the first_token_observed guard on the official summary. Unit, duration and scope are separate; shared batch and overlapping timings are non-additive. Inspect source_observations and row_evidence for complete captured context.
